name: Empty State
description: Centered illustration-style message with icon, title, text and an optional Universal Theme button. Use for no-data, first-run and error placeholders.
helpText: Place in a region (or use its markup as a report's No Data Found message). The button uses Universal Theme button classes so it matches native buttons in every theme style.

attributes.name: Title
attributes.helpText: Main message, for example No orders yet.

attributes.name: Message
attributes.helpText: Supporting sentence that tells the user what to do next.

attributes.name: Button Target URL
attributes.helpText: Optional target, for example f?p=&APP_ID.:10:&SESSION. or a column holding apex_page.get_url(...). Must be developer-controlled, never end-user input.

attributes.name: Button Label
attributes.helpText: Button text. The button renders only when both Target URL and Label are set.

attributes.name: Size
attributes.helpText: Compact fits inside cards and dialogs; Large suits full pages.

attributes.name: Dashed Border
attributes.helpText: Outline the area with a dashed border, useful for drop zones and first-run panels.

attributes.name: Icon Value
attributes.helpText: Optional Font APEX icon class from the source query, for example case when :P10_SEARCH is not null then 'fa-search' else 'fa-inbox' end. When not empty it replaces the static Icon, so one region can show a search icon for no results and an inbox for no data.
